import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')
# Create pnpm-workspace.yaml
workspace = '''packages:
  - "packages/*"
  - "apps/*"
'''
sftp = c.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/tmp/pnpm-workspace.yaml', 'w') as f:
    f.write(workspace)
c.exec_command('cp /tmp/pnpm-workspace.yaml /opt/areloria/')
# Update root package.json with workspace deps
root_pkg = '''{
  "name": "@arelororian/monorepo",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "pnpm -r build",
    "dev:2d": "pnpm --filter @arelorian/client-2d dev",
    "build:2d": "pnpm --filter @arelorian/client-2d build",
    "build:network": "pnpm --filter @arelorian/core-network build"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=18",
    "pnpm": ">=8"
  }
}
'''
with sftp.file('/tmp/package.json', 'w') as f:
    f.write(root_pkg)
c.exec_command('cp /tmp/package.json /opt/areloria/')
print("✅ pnpm workspace configured!")
# List structure
c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/packages/core-network/")
c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/apps/client-2d/")
c.close()
EOF
✅ pnpm workspace configured!
